title: Yellow Zesty Italian Carrot Tagliatelle
description: A vibrant, citrusy, and slightly sweet pasta dish loaded with fresh carrots, crunchy oregano, and a hint of zesty lemon
instructions: In a large pot of boiling salted water, cook the tagliatelle pasta according to the package instructions until al dente
While the pasta is cooking, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant, stirring occasionally
Add the sliced carrots to the skillet and cook for 5-7 minutes until they start to soften and lightly caramelize
Add the chopped oregano, grated lemon zest, and lemon juice to the skillet and stir to combine
Stir in the grated parmesan cheese until melted and smooth
Drain the cooked tagliatelle pasta and add it to the skillet with the carrot mixture
Toss the pasta and carrot mixture together over low heat for 1-2 minutes until well combined and slightly coated in the sauce
Season the dish with salt and black pepper to taste
Serve the tagliatelle hot, garnished with additional chopped oregano and lemon zest if desired
